$note: Asset harmony (tools/assets/harmony.py, look round 2). Every world master is measured against the reference set on the same scale (world units), and the measurable differences become per-asset corrections that preblur.py app bakes into the app's sprites. Change a target or a tolerance only with the harmony contact sheet in the PR. L and C are CIELAB lightness and chroma; tint is the mean a*, b* of the near-neutral pixels (the light's white balance).

reference.$note: What each kind is matched against: the approved island take (ADR-0018's style target, island-main-s; the app now draws the large plate, which is matched to it like any other world asset) for the world, Pofu for characters (a white bunny's chroma or a character's eyes say nothing about the lawn).

guard.$note: Measured and scored, never corrected (fnmatch patterns). Pofu is the hero and keeps his own art (char-guard). Sky elements and the far isles are lit and hazed by the colour script on purpose, so they are not matched to the lawn.

ppu_by_kind.$note: Pixels per world unit for masters the app does not ship yet (the shipped ones take preblur's). A station canvas is 120 units wide (station guide); characters match Mochi (871 px for 30 units); world plates match the home plate.

correction.$note: How far a correction moves toward the reference (1 = all the way) and its caps. The chroma cap reaches 1.45 because soft-lock masters were baked at chroma x0.7, so a correction can bring them back to lock-light.

kinds.$note: The kind of each shipped source (preblur's APP_SOURCES) that is not a station.

correct_by_kind.$note: Which metrics may be corrected per kind (all when a kind is absent). A character's identity is its own colour: a white bunny is not under-saturated, so characters only get white balance; their other outliers are reported for the next generation.

chains.$note: Station level chains (tea-stall-1 ... tea-stall-5). Each level was redrawn from its locked parent and locked again, losing about 30 % chroma per level (art queue finding, PR #67: çay ocağı median chroma 31 -> 11 from L1 to L5, windmill 28 -> 7). A level's black point, white point and median chroma are matched to its chain's L1 as corrected, with a chroma scale up to x3. New losses are stopped at promote time by the pipeline's edit_chroma QA check (an edit below 0.70 of its parent's chroma fails); harmony only restores the chains already generated.

materials_file.$note: Materials live in the material library, design/art/materials.json (look round 3): a hue and chroma range per material, corrected only when the generator drifted out of it. load_config() reads it under 'materials'.
